title: note.move.workbench payload (v2, closed)
description: Payload of note.move.workbench. Producer: app/agents/panel_agent/runtime.py downstream emission for zone_move actions (note_uuid/note_path/action_id/params). Consumer: handle_note_move_workbench requires note_path and reads params.destination_zone. params stays open (config-driven). Closed contract (#5704): undeclared top-level fields are rejected; producer extras belong under `extensions`. v1 stays registered for rows already tagged `note.move.workbench.v1`.

event_id.description: Envelope event id the worker run() loop copies into the payload before dispatch; carried onto retries.

_worker_retry_enqueued_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the worker retry enqueue.

extensions.description: The only open extension point: producer-specific extras must be nested here, never added as undeclared top-level fields.
